about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-reminders.mjs (a made-up student). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

bank account.ask: Yes, can you remind me to open a bank account?
bank account.reply:
That is a handy one to have on your list, and you can add it right away. 

{{task: Open a bank account}}

two things.ask: Yes please, opening a bank account and getting a bus pass

add it for me.ask: Yes, add it for me please
add it for me.reply: Only you can add it to your [[Checklist]] using the add button on the card.

already there.ask: Yes, can you remind me to register with a GP?
already there.reply: That's already on your checklist. You can find it on your [[Checklist]] page.

worried.ask: I’m really worried about money, I can’t afford food this week
worried.reply:
I am really sorry to hear you are struggling with food this week. 

Take a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] for immediate help with food and money worries.

conversation.reply: Unpacking takes time, so take it easy. Since you like chess and gigs, you might enjoy [[Chess]] or checking out [[Gigs]] for live music.
Yes, [[Chess]] is a great one to join. You can also visit the [[Societies]] page to browse more groups.
You can check out [[Gigs]] for live music events at the Students' Union.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else you would like reminding about while you settle in?
That is no problem at all. Let me know if anything comes up later.
You too! Have a lovely evening, and let me know if you need anything else.
